5974.title: Missing properties extension in editor language routing
5974.rootCauseOneLine: The editor extension map omits properties, so language selection falls back to plaintext and the opener does not claim the extension.
5974.proposedFix: Add properties mapped to ini without removing the existing ini mapping; cover opener eligibility and case-insensitive language selection.
5974.caveats: Browser Automation could not start because Chrome/Chromium is absent. No screenshot or full-app visual claim. An initial whole-repo build hit an unrelated GitHub plugin SDK build-order failure; affected plugin tests, lint, typecheck, and Monaco asset staging passed.
